faqs: How much does custom AI development cost?

It is build hours times rate, plus model usage. Upwork lists $30 to $150 an hour for AI developers, so a hypothetical 300 hour build is about $9,000 to $45,000. A hypothetical 10,000 conversations a month then costs about $110 a month on Claude Sonnet 5.5 at list prices.
How much does an AI developer cost per hour?

Upwork's median ranges are $30 to $150 an hour for AI developers, $35 to $60 for artificial intelligence engineers and $50 to $200 for machine learning engineers (read November 26, 2026). A US software developer earns a median $135,980 a year (BLS, May 2025), about $93 an hour with benefits on our estimate.
How much does a machine learning engineer charge?
Upwork splits it by experience: $50 to $80 an hour for beginners, $80 to $120 for intermediate engineers and $120 to $200 or more for advanced engineers who lead complex AI projects.
How much does it cost to run a custom AI tool each month?

It depends on tokens. A hypothetical 30 million input and 5 million output tokens a month costs $5.50 on Claude Haiku 5.5, $110 on Claude Sonnet 5.5 or gpt-6.2-sol, and $220 on Claude Opus 5.5 at list prices. Anthropic's Batch API halves the Claude token prices.
Can I fine-tune an OpenAI model for my business?

Not as a new customer. OpenAI's pricing page says fine-tuning is closed to new users; existing users can keep training for the coming months, and the listed fine-tuning models (gpt-4.1 and gpt-4.1-mini) are marked deprecated.
Is custom AI cheaper than an off-the-shelf AI tool?

Not always. Custom has a one-off build cost, $9,000 to $45,000 for a hypothetical 300 hours at Upwork AI developer rates, but a usage bill set by your own volume. The off-the-shelf chat tools we priced usually charge per seat, message or conversation instead. Compare the yearly totals for your own volume.
body:
Short answer. On Upwork, custom AI development costs $30 to $150 an hour for an AI developer and $50 to $200 for a machine learning engineer, going by Upwork's own rate pages (read November 26, 2026). A hypothetical 300 hour build therefore runs about $9,000 to $45,000 at AI developer rates. After launch you also pay for the model: a hypothetical assistant handling 10,000 conversations a month costs about $110 a month on Claude Sonnet 5.5 and about $5.50 on Claude Haiku 5.5 at list prices.

So there are two bills, not one: the hours to build it and the tokens to run it. This guide prices both from public sources, shows the arithmetic, and ends with a budget checklist. If you only need advice and a plan, our guide to AI consulting cost covers that side.

Custom AI development cost per hour

We read Upwork's median hourly ranges for three AI roles. Upwork runs the marketplace it reports on, so it has a stake in these numbers, and its footnote says they are "typical hourly rate ranges of certain historical contracts worldwide" and that what clients pay is negotiated.

Role or routeHourly costSource
Upwork, artificial intelligence engineer$35 to $60Upwork rate page
Upwork, AI developer$30 to $150Upwork rate page
Upwork, machine learning engineer$50 to $200Upwork rate page
US software developer, wage onlyabout $65.38BLS, $135,980 / 2,080 hours
US software developer, with benefitsabout $93our estimate from BLS ECEC

Upwork also splits the machine learning range by experience: $50 to $80 an hour for beginners on "well-defined tasks under supervision", $80 to $120 for intermediate engineers who "may lead small projects", and $120 to $200+ for advanced engineers "capable of leading complex AI projects".

What an in-house AI hire costs

The Bureau of Labor Statistics has no "AI developer" job title, so we use three related occupations in its Occupational Outlook Handbook. Median pay for 2025:

Occupation (BLS)Median payPer hourWith benefits (our estimate)
Software developers$135,980 a year (May 2025)about $65.38about $93
Data scientists$120,230 a year$57.80about $83
Computer and information research scientists$140,300 a year$67.45about $96

The benefits column is our arithmetic. In the BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation release for June 2026, wages and salaries were 70.0 percent of private industry employer costs and benefits the other 30.0 percent. Dividing each hourly wage by 0.70 gives the loaded figure. That is an approximation: the 70 percent is an average across all private industry jobs, not a figure for AI roles. On it, a software developer costs about $194,000 a year with benefits, and BLS lists a master's degree as the typical entry education for research scientists. The wages are for 2025 and the benefit share for June 2026, so the periods differ. The software developer hourly figure is our conversion of the annual wage; BLS's own hourly figure of $64.44 covers developers, QA analysts and testers together.

What a custom AI build costs by size

Build cost is hours times rate. The hour counts below are hypothetical sizes we chose to show the arithmetic, not benchmarks; we found no primary source for how many hours an AI project takes. Your scope sets the real number.

Hypothetical sizeUpwork AI developer ($30 to $150)Upwork ML engineer, intermediate ($80 to $120)US developer, loaded (about $93)
150 hours (hypothetical)$4,500 to $22,500$12,000 to $18,000about $14,000
300 hours (hypothetical)$9,000 to $45,000$24,000 to $36,000about $28,000
600 hours (hypothetical)$18,000 to $90,000$48,000 to $72,000about $56,000

A build that needs an advanced machine learning engineer costs more: 300 hours at Upwork's $120 to $200+ band is $36,000 to $60,000 or more. If your build is an integration on top of a hosted model rather than a new model, we suggest starting with the AI developer band and keeping machine learning engineer rates for work that trains or evaluates models.

A worked first-year total

Put the two bills together for one hypothetical project: 300 build hours at Upwork's AI developer band, then 12 months of the 10,000 conversation workload priced in the next section.

Model it runs onBuild (300 h at $30 to $150)Usage, 12 monthsFirst-year total
Claude Haiku 5.5$9,000 to $45,000$66$9,066 to $45,066
Claude Sonnet 5.5$9,000 to $45,000$1,320$10,320 to $46,320
Claude Opus 5.5$9,000 to $45,000$2,640$11,640 to $47,640

At this volume the build is most of the first-year cost, so the rate and hours you agree matter more than the model. The balance shifts as volume grows: usage scales with every conversation, while the build is paid once. Hosting and upkeep are not in these totals.

The running cost: model usage per month

A custom AI tool that calls a hosted model pays per token. These are list prices per million tokens, read on November 26, 2026:

ModelInput per 1M tokensOutput per 1M tokensSource
Claude Haiku 5.5 (prompts up to 100,000 tokens)$0.10$0.50Anthropic pricing
Claude Sonnet 5.5$2$10Anthropic pricing
gpt-6.2-sol$2.00$10.00OpenAI pricing
Claude Opus 5.5$4$20Anthropic pricing

Here is a hypothetical workload: 10,000 conversations a month, each with 3,000 input tokens and 500 output tokens. That is 30 million input and 5 million output tokens.

  • Claude Haiku 5.5: 30 x $0.10 + 5 x $0.50 = $5.50 a month, $66 a year.
  • Claude Sonnet 5.5 or gpt-6.2-sol: 30 x $2 + 5 x $10 = $110 a month, $1,320 a year.
  • Claude Opus 5.5: $220 a month.

Work that can wait is cheaper: Anthropic says its Batch API gives "a 50 percent discount on both input and output tokens", which takes the Sonnet example to $55. For more vendors, see our AI model API pricing comparison and OpenRouter pricing.

Fine-tuning on OpenAI: closed to new users

Training your own version of a model is a cost line some builds plan for. On OpenAI that door is mostly shut: its pricing page says "Fine-tuning is closed to new users", existing users "can continue training for the coming months", and the only models listed there, gpt-4.1 and gpt-4.1-mini, are marked deprecated. We did not check other vendors' fine-tuning terms. For a small business build we suggest a hosted model plus your own data in the prompt, priced by the token table above.

Custom AI or an off-the-shelf tool

The off-the-shelf AI chat tools we priced earlier sell by the seat, the message or the conversation, so you rent their features. Our guide to AI chatbot for business cost lists those price cards. A custom build has a one-off cost (the hours) plus a usage bill set by your own volume.

We would build custom when the workflow is your edge, when the tool must connect to systems a packaged product does not support, or when per-seat pricing grows past the usage bill. We would start off the shelf when the need is standard and speed matters. For the general software side, our custom software development cost guide uses the same rate method.

What pushes the price up or down

Upwork lists five factors for machine learning rates: experience level, project complexity, specialized skills ("deep learning or natural language processing can increase rates"), industry demand and geographic location. On the running side, three levers move the bill: the model you pick (Haiku 5.5 is 20 times cheaper per output token than Sonnet 5.5), how many tokens each request sends, and whether jobs can run in batch.

How to budget a custom AI project

  1. Name one task. One workflow with a clear before and after is easier to price than "AI for the business". Our AI implementation guide lays out a first pilot.
  2. Ask for hours by feature. Compare rates and hours separately across bidders.
  3. Pick a rate band. $30 to $150 an hour for AI developers, $80 to $120 for intermediate ML engineers on Upwork, about $93 for a US developer with benefits on our estimate.
  4. Estimate tokens per request. Multiply by monthly volume and the list price, as in the example above.
  5. Add what we did not price. Hosting, a vector database, monitoring and upkeep. Ask each bidder to quote them.

How imisofts can help

Our AI automation agency team can scope a build with hours by feature and a token estimate for the model it runs on. What we could not verify

  • Typical hours for an AI project: no primary source found, so every hour count here is hypothetical.
  • Hosting, vector database and monitoring prices: not priced for this guide.
  • Agency hourly rates for AI work by country: not read for this guide.
